great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote:
3.1.8 Benefit : Unlimited Automatic Recharge
... automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year...
(iii) Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness except for claim under Any one Illness condition.
great.explanation: The policy allows unlimited reinstatement of the base Sum Insured within the same policy year, including for the same illness except under the 'Any One Illness' condition. This means you get extensive extra coverage after exhausting your base Sum Insured.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote:
3.1.11 Benefit : No Claim Bonus Protect:
... enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis...
(i) ... shall not exceed 200% of the Sum Insured...
3.1.14 Benefit: Inflation Shield
This benefit is designed to provide additional increase in Sum Insured under this Policy on the basis of inflation rate...
great.explanation: You can increase your Sum Insured by 50% each year up to double the base amount through No Claim Bonus Protect, plus get additional increases linked to inflation. This provides meaningful extra coverage beyond the base Sum Insured.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote:
4.1. Standard Exclusions:
(a) Waiting Periods:
(i) Pre-Existing Diseases: Code- Excl01
... excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the start of coverage. This is a standard waiting period that balances risk and coverage.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote:
4.1. Standard Exclusions:
(a) Waiting Periods:
(ii) Specific Waiting Period: Code- Excl02
... excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses are excluded for 24 months from policy start, which is the industry standard for specific illness waiting periods.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote:
4.1. Standard Exclusions:
(a) Waiting Periods:
(iii) 30-day waiting period- Code- Excl03
... treatment of any illness within 30 days... shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident...
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days except if caused by an accident. This is a common initial waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote:
3.1.2 Benefit : Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses and Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses
(i) Under Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person’s date of admission...
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered, providing good support for related pre-hospital care.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote:
4.2. Specific Exclusions:
(b) Permanent Exclusions:
1. Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).

Annexure I - List of Expenses Generally Excluded ("Non-medical")...
... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ...
bad.explanation: Non-medical consumables like gloves and masks are excluded, meaning you may have to pay out-of-pocket for these during hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote:
3. Benefits Covered Under The Policy:
3. The Co-payment proportion (if applicable) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim...
...
3.2.6 Optional Benefit : Co-Payment Option
... on opting this optional Benefit... will bear a Co-payment... as specified in the Policy Schedule...
bad.explanation: Co-payment applies if specified and there is an optional co-pay benefit for seniors, but the default co-pay for the base plan is not clearly stated here. Any mention of co-pay makes the policy less favorable.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote:
3.1.1 (iii) (a)
The Policy Schedule will specify the eligibility of Room Rent or Room Category applicable...
ii. Single Private AC Room...
iii. If the Policy Schedule states ‘up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day’ as eligible Room Rent...
unclear.explanation: Room rent coverage depends on your Policy Schedule and may range from Single Private AC Room to a capped amount of 1% of Sum Insured per day, which affects claim calculations. The exact benefit is unclear without the schedule.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote:
3.1.2 ...
(ii) Under Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 90 days immediately after the Insured Person’s date of discharge...
unclear.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for 90 days after discharge, which is reasonable but does not clearly meet good or great standards.

unclear.name: NCB Reset
unclear.quote:
3.1.11 Benefit : No Claim Bonus Protect:
... 50% flat... provided that no Claim has been paid... or total claim amount payable does not exceed the 25% of the base Sum Insured...
(vii) In the event of total claim amount payable exceeds 25% of the base Sum Insured during any Policy Year, the accrued Cumulative Bonus will be reduced at same rate at which it is accrued...
unclear.explanation: The No Claim Bonus increases Sum Insured by 50% annually but reduces proportionally if claims exceed 25% of base Sum Insured, so it is not fully non-resetting.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
